rows.quote: Genetic association data for HCC were sourced from the FinnGen cohort (finngen‐R11‐HCC, with 609 patients and 345,118 controls; https://www.finngen.fi/en/) [23] and the IEU OpenGWAS project (ieu‐b‐4953, with 168 patients and 372,016 controls; https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/datasets/) (Table 1).
rows.coder_note: The sentence writes the FinnGen file as finngen-R11-HCC, release R11 (rule A); the same form recurs in the tables and results; the endpoint counts 609/345,118 are not a release N (rule H) and nothing conflicts.

rows.coder_note: Rule B: the sentence gives the OpenGWAS accession ieu-b-4953, which no dictionary row lists (the MRC-IEU row covers ukb-b and ukb-d identifiers only).

rows.quote: METHODS: Genetic association data for circulating plasma proteins and 2821 protein-to-protein ratios were sourced from the UKB PPP and Suhre's study.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names Suhre's study as the source of the 2821 protein-to-protein ratio associations; the dictionary has no row for a protein-ratio QTL study by Suhre (its only Suhre row is KORA 2017 protein levels, which the sentence does not describe), and the row has no candidates.

The pQTL data are attributed to reference 22, a bioRxiv preprint (DOI 10.1101/2022.06.17.496443) that is not a source identifier of any dictionary row, so the entry cannot carry a code; the table lines give only an approximate sample size (54,000) and European population, which single out no UKB-PPP row.
